R02.text: Over the past 14 days, your sleep, activity duration (~55 min/day), resting heart rate (~56 bpm), HRV (~45 ms), and low movement remained very close to your 28-day baseline. Sleep averaged ~470 min, consistently ending at 07:00. The major change is in steps: they dropped from a baseline average of ~8,009/day to ~2,335/day, a ~71% decrease sustained across all 14 days, affecting weekdays and weekends alike. Despite this large reduction in recorded steps, your active minutes did not change, suggesting step counting conditions changed while overall active time was maintained. Other metrics showed no corresponding shift.

R03.text: During the 28-day baseline, steps averaged ~8009 per day with sleep ~470 min (start ~22:50, end 07:00), activity ~55 min, low movement ~451 min, resting heart rate 55-57 bpm, and HRV RMSSD 43-47 ms. In the 14-day window, steps declined sharply to a mean of ~2335 per day, roughly one-third of baseline. Sleep timing, duration, activity duration, low movement, RHR, and HRV remained stable and near baseline levels throughout. No other metric changed meaningfully alongside the step decrease. Wear compliance was complete across all 42 days.
